title: Incorrect comparison operator handling in MIR rewrite
finding: The `_ => eq_call` arm in the __eq__ rewrite incorrectly rewrites non-Eq/NotEq comparisons (<, <=, >, >=) between same-class instances to __eq__ calls instead of falling through to the default MirExpr::Compare.
fix: Added `matches!(op, Eq | NotEq)` guard before entering the __eq__ rewrite block; restructured the match to if/else to avoid an unreachable `_` arm.

title: Inconsistent indentation in test fixture struct initialization
finding: Indentation of is_dataclass/dataclass_fields fields in test fixtures was inconsistent with surrounding fields.
fix: Ran cargo fmt --all to normalize indentation across all affected files.

category: Codegen panic from non-scalar dataclass fields
title: P1: Reject non-scalar dataclass fields before synthesis
finding: Codex bot claimed annotation_to_ty accepts non-scalar types (list[int], Other) for dataclass fields, leading to a codegen panic in scalar_to_slot_word. Verified by testing: annotation_to_ty already rejects list[int] and Other with C0001 before the field is added. The finding's premise is false.

title: P2: Gate instance comparison acceptance on equality operators
finding: Codex bot correctly identified that the type checker discarded the comparison operator (op: _) and accepted any same-class comparison when __eq__ existed, including < and >=. Verified: p1 < p2 panicked in codegen. Fixed by preserving op and only accepting Eq/NotEq for dataclass instance comparisons.
fix: Changed op: _ to op, added matches!(op, CmpOp::Eq | CmpOp::NotEq) guard, restricted to is_dataclass classes. Added integration test reject_ordering_between_dataclass_instances.

title: P2: Validate __eq__ signatures before MIR rewriting
finding: Codex bot correctly identified that user-defined __eq__ with wrong arity or return type was accepted, causing LLVM IR verification panic. Verified: def __eq__(self, other: C) -> int panicked. Fixed by restricting the type checker and MIR rewrite to dataclass classes only (whose synthesized __eq__ has a known-correct signature).
fix: Restricted type checker comparison acceptance to is_dataclass classes. Restricted MIR __eq__ rewrite to is_dataclass classes. Updated test a_same_class_instance_comparison_with_eq_type_checks to a_same_class_dataclass_instance_comparison_with_eq_type_checks. Added test a_non_dataclass_instance_comparison_with_user_eq_is_t0021. Added integration test reject_eq_between_non_dataclass_instances_with_user_eq.

title: P2: Preserve declared __repr__ call type
finding: Codex bot correctly identified that the MIR __repr__ rewrite matched by name only, so a user-defined __repr__ with wrong return type or arity was rewritten to a fabricated call typed as Ty::Str, causing a codegen panic. Verified: def __repr__(self) -> int panicked. Fixed by restricting the MIR __repr__ rewrite to dataclass classes only.
fix: Added is_dataclass guard to rewrite_instance_to_repr. Non-dataclass instances pass through unchanged (codegen panics honestly with 'not supported yet'). Updated docs and ADR D-164.

category: Codegen panic from non-scalar dataclass field
title: P1: Reject non-scalar dataclass field types before codegen
finding: A self-referential dataclass field (`next: Node` or `next: Self`) is accepted by `annotation_to_ty` (which resolves self-referential class names and `Self` to `Ty::Instance`) but panics in codegen with 'internal error: cannot store this value into an instance attribute slot'. The dataclass synthesis at class.rs:1209 sets `attrs = merged_fields.clone()` directly, bypassing `collect_init_attrs`/`slot_ty_from_init_rhs` which would have rejected non-scalar attributes. The earlier P1 refutation (round 3) only tested `list[int]` and cross-class `Other`, missing the self-referential case that `annotation_to_ty` actually accepts. Verified: `@dataclass class Node: next: Node` panicked at crates/pycc_codegen/src/lib.rs:915.
fix: Added `is_scalar_slot_type` helper and a scalar-type validation check in the dataclass field collection loop, rejecting `Ty::Instance`, `Ty::None`, `Ty::List`, `Ty::Dict`, `Ty::Set`, `Ty::Tuple`, and `Ty::Infer` with C0001 before the field is added to `dataclass_fields`. Added HIR unit tests for self-referential, Self, None, and cross-class fields. Added integration tests for self-referential, Self, and None fields. Updated ADR D-164 and TYPE_SYSTEM.md.
